verses.20:112: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنࣱ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلۡمࣰ ا وَلَا هَضۡمࣰ ا

meaning: The root هضم (hDm) primarily refers to something melting or dissolving after being congealed. It also describes fruit becoming broken, crushed, or mellow, making it easy to digest.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
